title: The Judgment on the Prince of Tyre
description: The word of the Lord came to Ezekiel concerning the prince of Tyre, who in his pride said: "I am a god; I sit on the throne of God in the heart of the seas." He is wiser than Daniel and has gathered gold and silver through his wisdom and trade, but his heart became proud. Therefore the Lord will bring the most ruthless nations against him. They will draw their swords against his splendor, cast him down into the grave, and kill him in the heart of the seas. He shall die the death of the uncircumcised, for the Lord has spoken. [ref:Esek 28:1-10|Ezekiel 28:1-10]
